scope: synthetic engineering checks of design defaults (unverified); no calibrated attention claim
checks: stream share matches the spec sanity values: u 0.2 -> 0.64, 0.05 -> 0.10, 0.8 -> 0.97
with noise held fixed, raising topic fit, speaker closeness, mentioned closeness or goal match never lowers a
fatigue, stream load and dysregulation never raise a_raw; capacity peaks at mid arousal (inverted_u) or is flat (monotone)
config fails fast: weights must sum to 1, a_gist < a_full, theta > 0, known keys, choices and well-formed tag tables
soft OR: B = 1 gives u = 1 whatever T; B is the max of surprise, threat (scaled by threat sensitivity) and being addressed
golden regression: enabled=false gives a byte-identical scripted 10-day household world; enabled runs with and without sleep
default closeness: recorded value, else family from identity facts (a parent hearing their child), else known, else stranger
same seed gives identical attention results whatever order events and recipients were scheduled in
a directly addressed event (or one naming the listener) is captured, FULL and needs a response; asleep, capacity is K_sleep, only B >= B_wake gets in
emotion: an uncaptured event moves mood by a fraction a of its impulse; a captured (threat) event moves it in full
NONE writes only a hidden receipt (no recall, no mood); GIST encodes who, topic and rough valence at lower stability; originals stay in the event log
a coarsened routine event still habituates: repeats reuse its original appraisal (no extra model call), never recalled
LLM context: NONE turns are left out of memories and conversation_so_far; GIST turns appear as one summary line

2000 sampled agents on identical events: high dysregulation gives lower mean and higher variance of a {'low_dys_mean_a': 0.294, 'high_dys_mean_a': 0.169, 'low_dys_var_a': 0.0203, 'high_dys_var_a': 0.0341}
2000 sampled agents: high threat sensitivity attends more to threat events than to neutral ones, and more than low {'high_ts_threat': 0.51, 'high_ts_neutral': 0.224, 'low_ts_threat': 0.475}

drift: bored listeners in a 120-turn stream drift more and keep fewer FULL traces than interested ones (bored {'drift_periods': 1781, 'drifted_events': 5956, 'full': 136}, interested {'drift_periods': 940, 'drifted_events': 2942, 'full': 3291}); capture ends a drift
a visitor line addressed to one person is captured for them and not addressed to the others who overhear it
felt ignored (flag, default off): a close speaker facing an inattentive listener loses closeness 25 times over 80 turns via Engine.relate, each logged; off changes nothing
crowded scene (30 listeners, 20 turns): traces drop from 600 to 418; addressed events all kept
cost: exactly W allocations for an event with W listeners, none while time passes, one call site (Engine.advance)
no branch keyed on agent type, role or diagnosis; differences come from traits, dials, mood and arousal
